name: Free Will Offerings
overview: Scripture presents free will offerings as voluntary gifts given to the LORD beyond obligatory vows and tithes, emphasizing their acceptance when offered without blemish (Leviticus 22:21-23). These offerings are distinct from vows and are brought alongside other sacrifices during appointed feasts and worship times (Leviticus 23:38; Numbers 29:39). The instructions in Deuteronomy highlight the sacredness of these free will offerings, forbidding their consumption within the giver’s gates, thereby underscoring their dedication to God (Deuteronomy 12:6, 12:17). Thus, free will offerings reflect a believer’s heartfelt devotion and willingness to honor God beyond prescribed duties.
